tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Whether the tenderer has submitted the copies of work orders that he has supplied food for government programs in at least 3 years out of the last 5 years.
Have given a satisfactory letter of supply of food for government programs and self-certification that the organization is not blacklisted.
Business expenditure of Rs.15.00 lakhs per annum in any of the 3 years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 on meals/breakfasts alone is furnished with actionable information.

Giving information about the premises where Food preparation is required and how many staff are there and whether permission letter/registration letter/food department letter etc. is provided from competent authority (department) for Food preparation at this place.
